hypothesis: On the original local value-write task, the optimized query may make the write behaviorally accessible by changing the direction of the two head reads that enter normalization. A direction-only read with the unedited magnitude should reproduce most of the answer control. A magnitude-only read with the unedited direction should lose it.
design: Keep all weights, the donor value write, query plan, untouched heads, gates and decoder fixed. At each of the four permitted positions, capture the pre-RMS raw read under the same optimized query with and without the write. Replay the written trajectory with the edited direction and unedited norm, the unedited direction and edited norm, or the actual unedited read. The full written and unedited optimized paths, native query and whitened-key baseline run on the actual model. Use headwise replacements upstream of the production gated RMS implementation. The axes are a matched direction-by-magnitude factorial. This is a causal mechanism test of the published 9B value-write finding, not a new general QA benchmark or an optimization proposal.
model: mlx-community/Qwen3.5-9B-4bit@8b2b98c00a6b4d291155e4890773ca8f769aee53; same model asset pins, layer 28, heads 28-29, generator, suffix and native-start 16-step solver as experiments/quantized_write.
dev: Reproduce the 16 known 4-bit transfer seeds 27112000 through 27112015, two formats, intended and nuisance writes. Check original optimized top tokens and margins on both written/unwritten paths against archived inference and the native write. Report donor/recipient vocabulary logits and answer success for every arm. If replacing both head reads by the unedited reads fails to reproduce even a single unwritten top token or changes any logit by more than 1e-5, stop interpretation.
promotion: For 32 target presentations, require at least 12 full successes, direction-only retaining all but at most one full success, at least 8 more target successes than magnitude-only, no new nuisance error in either arm, and the identical-head replacement check. Otherwise report the causal null or interaction and leave fresh seeds unopened.
test: Upon dev promotion, use exactly 64 new seeds 96374120 through 96374183, two presentation formats and both lookup/control roles. Report full, no-write, direction-only, magnitude-only, native and whitened-key. Confirm if direction-only retains >=95% of the full successes, exceeds magnitude-only by >=20 percentage points with seed-clustered 95% paired interval excluding zero, all nuisance and unwritten presentations return the recipient answer, and the implementation checks pass. Seed is the inferential unit. The original independent BF16 cohorts remain unchanged.
budget: Local Apple M5 only; 15 minutes dev, 35 minutes fresh confirmation, one implementation repair, no paid credits or standalone speed claims. Complete the running conversation pilot before switching GPU models. Geometry alone does not establish causal behavioral mediation.
interpretation: RMS normalization and angular vs radial decompositions are established. The empirical contribution is which component of this particular sparse memory write carries its answer-control effect at the two named heads under a fixed readout. Do not extrapolate this effect to all hybrid models.
geometry: Before any model run, also fix a descriptive comparison of the mean eight per-presentation raw direction angles (four positions times two heads) for native versus optimized queries. Record median across target presentations and normalized angular/radial energies. Use within-case medians only as descriptive measurements.
